name: Agronutris
tagline: French insect-protein producer with AI-managed black soldier fly facilities
description: Toulouse-based Agronutris built insect-protein production using AI-monitored rearing systems, originally targeting human food before pivoting to pet food and aquaculture feed. After raising EUR 100m in 2021 to construct a commercial-scale plant in Rethel that started production in 2023, its holding company EAP Group entered a safeguard procedure opened by the Sedan commercial court on 23 January 2025 amid the wider insect-protein crash that also took down Ynsect. EAP Group moved to judicial receivership in July 2025 and was liquidated, but in September 2025 La Compagnie des Insectes took majority control of the Rethel operating company via a ~EUR 10m round, with existing investors (Mirova, Bpifrance, Nutergia) retaining minority stakes; the plant and its ~80 jobs continued.

rejection_reason: Not a failure: only the EAP Group holding (Toulouse HQ/admin) was liquidated. The Agronutris operating company and Rethel plant (~80 staff) were rescued in Sept 2025 by La Compagnie des Insectes via a ~EUR 10m round, existing investors kept minority stakes, and the plant is still operating and hiring as of Sept 2026. Also only tenuously an AI startup.
total_loss: EUR 100m raised; safeguard procedure filed January 2025
